Triage Implementation (src/triage.mjs):

normalizeTicket(raw):

Validates that raw is a non-null object and all expected fields (id, title, customerId, severity, state) are strings; throws TypeError on invalid inputs.
Does not mutate input objects.
Trims all string values, lowercases severity and state.
Validates that id, title, and customerId are non-empty after trimming.
Enforces allowed severity (urgent, normal, low) and state (open, closed).
Returns a clean object containing only {id, title, customerId, severity, state}.


summarizeTickets(tickets):

Validates that tickets is an array; throws TypeError otherwise.
Normalizes each ticket entry using normalizeTicket.
Maintains ticket updates by keeping the last occurrence per ticket ID.
Filters to include only open tickets.
Generates { openCount, bySeverity, customerIds, queue } where:

bySeverity tracks { urgent, normal, low }.
customerIds contains unique customer IDs sorted in ascending order.
queue contains open ticket IDs ordered by priority (urgent -> normal -> low), using ascending ticket ID order to break ties.


Preserves both named exports.
